notes: One file per package; each package edits only its own file (plan X0 3.4).

track: universal (every profile) | profile_gated (only profiles that list it, or "*"). Every profile_gated correction needs a trigger_fixture: a hand-checkable toy whose old value appears under the frozen profile and new value under the corrected one.

applies_when selects the historical Runs a correction is relevant to (read-time advisories, X0 S10b): every listed key must match; an empty object matches every Run. Keys: modules_any, modes_any, data_packs_any, engines_any.
advisory: null, or {severity: info|low|medium|high|critical, title, summary, affected_metrics}. A Run that did not apply the correction and matches applies_when gets the advisory.

corrections.description: Runs record their methodology profile (id, version, definition and applied-correction hashes) in resolved-run.json, provenance and status; comparisons treat it as part of the method dimension.
A saved Study whose revision no longer matches the installed code is classified (code identity, method upgrade, content change, unverifiable) instead of being re-identified silently at run start.
